presented_options.A: all three rows — every fsynced WAL record is replayed on startup
presented_options.B: the two earliest rows — only WAL records that survive the CRC check are replayed; the trailing one is dropped

answers.rationale: The WAL records Begin, Insert, and Commit as separate records. Recovery groups records by txn_id and only applies committed transactions (those with a Commit record). Without a Commit record, the transaction's changes are discarded as uncommitted. The SELECT would see no rows.
